repositories.notes: License and reference paths pinned during publication audit on 2026-10-23. HUD data and host hooks were adapted through the separately pinned PC project; this does not claim its original port used this ThirteenAG revision.

changes: Original pre-Present observer uses upstream CPU registry and heuristic guest_backtrace; retained MIT notice applies to upstream interface excerpts.
Anchored COM overlay bounds D3DCAPS9 writes to304 bytes and disables NFSU2 mode-label writes and automatic size remapping.
Build renames three colliding NFSU2 wrapper symbols and rejects other duplicate definitions.

focused_callback_repair.reuse: Pinned recursive descent plus original mov/push probe rule, scoped to runtime-observed roots and newly required callback closure; original source licenses/notices retained under ignored work/.

sound_bank_integration.reuse: Original private bank parser/relocator and seeded recursive descent; content matching adapted to CPU* with full block and relocated-call checks, nested thread-local mappings and loaded return-address translation.
sound_bank_integration.permission: User-reported maintainer permission with attribution to codepdbh; original upstream files retained under ignored work/.

browser_bringup.reuse: Reversible overlays reuse the MIT-licensed th0mk browser shell and generic WebGPU, audio, input and WASI worker host. Original notices remain in the ignored source snapshot and patches/nfsu2-web.LICENSE.
browser_bringup.local_server: Handwritten Rust HTTP server and virtual-LAN relay; no upstream server implementation or game assets are copied.
browser_bringup.menu_redesign: Original browser/menu.html, menu.css, menu.ts and keyboard.ts; no game art or fonts copied. Physical-key aliases adapt the pinned upstream DirectInput/Windows key event bridge. Audio, lifecycle and controller options reuse existing host contracts; NFSU2-only game patches remain disabled.

startup_movie_controls.reuse: MIT-licensed notification adapter design and input baselining; NFSU1-specific handwritten implementation. Notice retained in patches/nfsu2-web.LICENSE.
startup_movie_controls.evidence: Local matching PC 1.4 executable and cached catalog; interface addresses in runtime/nfsu1_intro.c.

drag_loading_switch_recovery.implementation: Original catalog-adapter fallback for indexed tables matching saved jump targets and local blocks; no new discovery.
drag_loading_switch_recovery.reuse: Existing MIT guarded jump-table emission, retaining live word checks and indirect fallback; notice in patches/nfsu2-web.LICENSE.

profile_datetime_imports.implementation: Original NFSU1 Win32 helpers for GetDateFormatA and GetTimeFormatA; English (US) formatting and bounded guest buffers, not full Windows NLS emulation.
profile_datetime_imports.timezone_source: th0mk/nfsu2-web runtime/web/tz.c and runtime/web/compat/wasm_plat.h at 31da468582c3de14fd6f4233831f62816e2df83d; same retained MIT notice.

graphics_presets.implementation: Original NFSU1 presets after capability setup/profile load via Wasm LLD wrappers. Automatic resolution fits live canvas device pixels while preserving guest aspect, using the pinned browser settings and GPU device-reset host.
graphics_presets.evidence: Read-only matching PC 1.4 settings descriptor table at 0x700ec0, original four-level preset routine at 0x410ed0, capability limits at 0x701040 and config loader at 0x41c680. Exact mapping in runtime/nfsu1_graphics.c.
graphics_presets.reuse: No additional third-party source copied. Existing browser shell excerpts remain covered by patches/nfsu2-web.LICENSE; attribution to th0mk and the existing PC analysis pipeline by codepdbh/sp00nz is retained.
graphics_presets.limitations: Effect correctness and performance are incomplete. Widescreen FOV/HUD hooks are ported; smaller post-processing buffers retain original game sizing.

dynamic_resolution.source: th0mk/nfsu2-web runtime/web/gpu_web.c at pinned runtime revision
dynamic_resolution.reuse: Existing metal_view_size/view_follow and game-driven device loss/reset; normalized oversized view comparison prevents repeated resets. Existing MIT notice retained.

widescreen_layout_correction.implementation: Preserve generic frontend quad extents; scope HUD scale to four render operands and center to one comparison, leaving the shared float pool intact.
widescreen_layout_correction.evidence: Local PC 1.4 instruction inspection. Original mod comparison: https://github.com/ThirteenAG/WidescreenFixesPack/blob/master/source/NFSUnderground.WidescreenFix/Frontend.ixx

semantic_group_layout.implementation: Recognize noninteractive HUD and music components by their original FE object identities and inherit their canvas through group ancestry. Loading, menus, pause, results and unrecognized components use one centered canvas; pointer mapping uses that same centered canvas. Cached positions and animation values never select an edge.
semantic_group_layout.evidence: Read-only local PC 1.4 FE lookup and submission inspection: object name hash at +0x0C, object ID at +0x10, parent group index at +0x20, group slot stride 0xD0 and originating group object at slot +0x50. Stock private FNG metadata confirms loading frame/fill and Chyron music-banner ancestry. Decoded assets and emitted game code remain local.
semantic_group_layout.reuse: No additional third-party source copied. Existing PC analysis attribution and widescreen notices retained.
semantic_group_layout.limitations: Focused command-line checks validate host layout decisions; browser/game appearance remains user-validated.

character_skinning.implementation: Resolve matrix instruction rows through existing WGSL source-operand helper, preserving selected bone addressing and shader-defined constants.
character_skinning.evidence: Private effect inspection and bounded Node guest capture: startup-created character shader contains three relative matrix operations that translated to fixed bone-zero constants.
character_skinning.reuse: Pinned th0mk/nfsu2-web translator and source-operand helper under existing retained MIT notice.
character_skinning.limitations: Visible character deformation and animation support is incomplete.

artwork.author: Raze
artwork.scope: four DDS font atlases only, no gauges
artwork.distribution: optional private local import, no artwork bundled

format_references.scope: TPK v4 OldTextureInfo and pixel format layout; independent parser/writer

hd_fonts.implementation: Sparse local overlay of GLOBALA.BUN and LANGUAGETEXTURES.BIN; four scoped PC 1.4 font dimension operands; original game inputs preserved.

upload_correction.scope: Preserve top mip levels of exactly four 4x font atlases; retain original WorldLOD mip policy for all other textures.

language_streaming_correction.cause: Initial raw conversion removed a table required by the header-first language loader.
language_streaming_correction.implementation: Preserve compressed stream table and five unrelated compressed textures; literal-only JDLZ encoding for three imported language fonts.

depth_state_correction.implementation: Disable depth writes when ZENABLE is false and preserve persistent scene depth during smaller depth-disabled effect passes. Reopen scratch-only passes when depth is enabled; retain explicit clears.

online_corrections.reuse: Retarget the existing real monotonic NetTick adapter to NFSU1 thunk 0x66e8b0; retain original simulation timing and diagnostic virtual fallback.
online_corrections.protocol_evidence: Local PC 1.4 sender and receiver analysis: mesg ATTR is Dirtysock flags, nested GAME/PARAMS are carried inside escaped TEXT; +msg reads F/N/T.

online_car_data.evidence: PC 1.4 car-table loader and race-start check.
online_car_data.implementation: Original standard-library preparer restores only chunk 0x34600 table from verified local stock GLOBALB.BUN into ignored sparse GlobalB.lzc overlay. Source containers and guest checksum logic unchanged.
online_car_data.reuse: Reuses project-authored path/chunk/JDLZ helpers from tools/prepare_hd_fonts.py. No new third-party implementation copied.

online_profile_entry.reuse: CPU-state-preserving guest call pattern; NFSU1-specific identity and transition adapter authored from local PC 1.4 interface inspection.
online_profile_entry.evidence: Main-menu Online switch return 0x4b3454; active profile name at 0x7588c4 (13-byte field). Profile frontend 0x4cbe30 copies it into shared text-entry scratch 0x777b74, which must not be used as the persistent name. Persona success 0x55cc97 closes login lobby then opens car selection. Normal game-session lobby subsequently authenticates with the supplied identity.

keyboard_driving_bindings.implementation: Keep physical keyboard state, buffered events and Win32 text unchanged; apply browser-selected driving destinations through a separately reference-counted stream selected only by the pinned NFSU1 race action map.
keyboard_driving_bindings.evidence: Local PC 1.4 action-table labels and keyboard map switch; game-derived code and assets remain local.
keyboard_driving_bindings.validation: Focused browser-mailbox and native input checks; online chat and race behavior require user game validation.

online_room_name_quotes.implementation: Remove Dirtysock string quotes when storing and looking up room names, so predefined Main Lobby rooms match the client's space-containing NAME value.
online_room_name_quotes.evidence: Local PC 1.4 TagFieldSetString at 0x667950 quotes space-containing names. User log showed a 33-byte move followed by the 52-byte missing-room response and no roster or race-create response; custom rooms worked.
online_room_name_quotes.validation: Focused local relay regression for quoted room joins, creator roster and race creation; browser confirmation remains required.

audio_stream_freshness.implementation: Track consumed frames for non-static looping buffers partially rewritten during playback; report both Unlock regions, silence stale PCM and continue advancing DirectSound cursors.
audio_stream_freshness.validation: Native synthetic mixer smoke; browser/game confirmation required.

focus_loss_controls.reuse: Existing background setting and focus/lifecycle contracts; expose Pause / Keep running and default to Pause instead of forcing run. Runtime lifecycle uses PC 1.4 background polling flag 0x735e78, as tested by message pump 0x411030, instead of Winsock startup count (initialized even in single-player). Native synthetic lifecycle smoke covers this distinction; browser/game validation remains manual. MIT notice retained in patches/nfsu2-web.LICENSE.

minimap_projection.implementation: Bind immutable FLOAT3/FLOAT4 map declarations on SetFVF for both active programmable shaders and fixed conversion; preserve texture components and use projective sampling in generated/fallback fixed fragment shaders.
minimap_projection.evidence: Read-only PC 1.4 road-pass trace, user browser capture of VS1/PS1 with FVF20142 and stale declaration088004E0, and local command-line shader dump showing FLOAT2 UV declaration and existing PS1 projection.
minimap_projection.reuse: Pinned th0mk/nfsu2-web renderer and existing tcoord helper; existing MIT notice retained. D9VK issue 197 used for symptom comparison only; no D9VK code reused.
minimap_projection.validation: Authored-vertex FVF declaration smoke with actual CPU shader execution and generated WGSL inspection; Wasm link and browser bundle. User confirmed the minimap works after testing build nfsu1-local-29bd80b573e6; no browser operated by the agent.

touch_controls.implementation: Port mobile touch controls (menu D-pad, OK/Back/Keyboard text-entry bar, driving pedals with Gas-to-Nitro slide, gear buttons, Buttons/Thumb-stick/Tilt steering, 1-finger touch-to-mouse with 1-change-per-frame step queue and 2-finger drag, portrait layout and screen wake lock) from th0mk/nfsu2-web to NFSU1's native key and race-HUD state.
touch_controls.validation: TypeScript check, esbuild bundle, browser startup smoke, keyboard smoke and touch controls smoke.
